_comment: iOS-only strings (no web counterpart). Merged into L10nTable.swift by gen_l10n.py.

toast_offline.en: Can't reach the server — check your connection
toast_offline.zh: 连不上服务器,请检查网络后重试

gps_denied.en: Location access is off — allow it in Settings to remember where boxes are
gps_denied.zh: 没有定位权限,请到系统设置里允许,才能记住箱子的位置

gps_off_hint.en: Location is off; boxes are saved without a position
gps_off_hint.zh: 定位已关闭,入库时不记录位置
